> Diffpair Mapper

Click a spot on any board to drop a pin and name it — accept the default name or type your own. Give a pin on another board that same name (the box will suggest names already in use) and the two are treated as one net, e.g. a differential-pair leg on the SFP+ receptacle sharing a name with the matching leg on the VL813. A net isn't limited to two pins — call every ground pin GND and they all trace together. Scroll over an image to zoom in on fine traces. The Overlay board below flips between the top photo, the bottom photo, and a blend of both, pre-aligned pixel-for-pixel — switch layers to follow a trace from a front-side pad to where it lands on the back. Everything saves in this browser as you go.
